components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one firm Pine tap that commits the statement.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-2xl, 1.125rem); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary paper action, used to start another audit.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-2xl, 1.125rem); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Wordmark Nav
components.description: 56px paper bar with lowercase unfold; home link only.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 3.5rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: var(--background); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-nav-wordmark { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--foreground); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-wordmark:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); border-radius: 0.25rem; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Sealed 24px unit of work: one card per job.
components.html:
Analyze statement

Choose a bank profile, then upload the statement export.

Statement CSV
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.25rem; overflow: hidden; padding: 1.25rem 0; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-card-header, .ds-card-body { padding: 0 1.25rem; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card-desc { margin: 0.375rem 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

components.name: Wash Field
components.description: 18px washed field; transparent border at rest, Ring halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-input { height: 2rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-2xl, 1.125rem); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input) 50%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; transition: color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms, border-color 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:hover { } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: File Input Group
components.description: Washed group with muted icon addon; focus ring sits on the group.
components.css: .ds-input-group { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 2rem; width: 100%; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-2xl, 1.125rem); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input) 50%, transparent); transition: color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms, border-color 200ms; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', sans-serif); } .ds-input-addon { display: flex; align-items: center; padding-left: 0.5rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input-group-control { flex: 1; height: 100%; border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0 0.625rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-input-group-control::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input-group-control:focus { outline: none; } .ds-input-group:focus-within { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Count Badge
components.description: Cool Wash count chip beside a results title.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius-2xl, 1.125rem); background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Destructive Alert
components.description: Paper-ground error; Signal Red type, not a flooded card.

components.css: .ds-empty { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 3rem; text-align: center; border: 1px dashed var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-3xl, 1.375rem); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', sans-serif); } .ds-empty-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-empty-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-empty-desc { margin: 0; max-width: 24rem; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

narrative.overview:
unfold's interface treats privacy as a material, not a slogan. The screen is a sealed paper field: white, hairline-edged, and chromatically silent until the user must act. Then Pine fires once, on the control that commits the statement. That tap is tactile and confident; everything around it stays quiet.

The system is Inter Variable at every rank, shadcn base-rhea geometry with pill-rounded controls and larger sealed cards, and depth that is tonal rather than theatrical. Cards sit on the page through a 1px ink-whisper ring and a faint shadow. Nothing floats. Nothing ornaments. The job is a short local audit, so the layout stays a single centered column, not a dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Inter Variable for heading and body; no second family
Pine as the sole chromatic accent, used on committing actions
Hairline ring plus faint shadow; no floating chrome
Light paper default; dark tokens exist as a theme, not the primary chrome

rules.name: The Pine Tap Rule
rules.body: Pine appears on the action that commits, and almost nowhere else. Filling a header, a page wash, or decorative shapes with Pine breaks the seal.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Primary and accent are the same Pine token. Do not introduce a second brand hue.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Heading and body share Inter Variable. --font-heading is an alias of --font-sans, not a second face.

rules.name: The Short Audit Rule
rules.body: If a screen needs a second column to feel complete, the layout has drifted.

rules.name: The Hairline Seat Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces sit on Paper via a 1px ink-whisper ring and a faint shadow. Do not add large drop shadows, glass, or gradient scrims.

rules.name: The Soft Seal Rule
rules.body: Interactive chrome is 18px. Cards are 24px. Do not mix sharp 4px rectangles into this vocabulary, and do not fully pill large surfaces.

dos: Do keep the wordmark lowercase "unfold" in Inter semibold.
Do spend Pine on the committing control; let Paper and Ink do the rest.
Do seat cards with a hairline ring and a faint shadow.
Do use 18px seals on controls and 24px on cards.
Do keep new screens in the centered 3xl/5xl column.
donts: Don't introduce a second typeface or a display/serif pairing.
Don't paint headers, page backgrounds, or illustration with Pine.
Don't add accounts, avatars, cloud glyphs, or social proof; those break the sealed, non-invasive product.
Don't use heavy drop shadows, glass, or gradient scrims.
Don't treat the unused isometric hero.png as brand art; it is not in this system.
